'''Ronton's Galactic Dictionary''' was a dictionary published in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. ''[[The Despotica]]'', the canon of literature related to [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]], was so expansive that the dictionary was forced to regularly redefine its definition of the word "literature."
